_doc: A start objective (GDD 4.16). Done when every condition is met (all of them). A condition counts the events of type `event` of the family (the event's family field, or its actor's family) whose fields match `match`: a plain value is equality; {"gte": n} / {"lte": n} / {"ne": v} compare. count = how many such events (each event counts 1). Progress counts only while the objective is the current one of the chain. name_key: the text in the HUD.
